parallel.requirements: Reimplement Doxygen 1.17.0 behavior from the provided executable and README only, covering CLI/template/config/output/documentation behavior without source-code reuse.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent planned broad exploration, created a config TaskCreate item, launched a workflow with eight probe agents and a critic, then kept final implementation in the parent.
parallel.implementation: Parent built option metadata and generated config/resource support, wrote resources.cpp, resources.h, configoptions.h, and embedded harvested files, but did not complete the core executable implementation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Final artifact contained partial support files, resources, generated data, copied res trees, README/LICENSE, and executable, but lacked a coherent completed C++ program tree.
parallel.verification: Many probe checks and local comparisons were run, but no completed integrated build/evaluator-aligned acceptance evidence appears before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow was killed with multiple probe retries still in progress, final response was empty, process timed out, and official evaluation reported compile_failed with zero tests run.

serial.requirements: Reimplement Doxygen 1.17.0 behavior from allowed behavioral observation and bundled documentation, without delegation or source-code shortcuts.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single parent agent locally probed the binary, generated config data, gathered resources, wrote source modules, and ran local comparisons without child ownership boundaries.
serial.implementation: Serial produced a broader implementation tree: tools, configdata/config, message, util, resources, emoji, templates, doxygen.h, main.cpp, and resource data.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact contained the broader source tree and resources but still did not produce a compiling accepted solution.
serial.verification: Serial ran many direct probes and exact-output checks, including config formatting and CSS substitution comparisons, but no official acceptance passed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The agent timed out, final response was empty, artifact validation failed, and official evaluation reported compile_failed with zero tests run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the reverse-engineering requirement and Doxygen scope, including CLI, config parsing, config options, comment parsing, generated outputs, engine semantics, and messages.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run recognized the same prompt constraints and Doxygen behavior surface, using the README and executable as allowed evidence.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement recognition difference explains the official outcome; the difference is how the same broad task was explored and implemented.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent split exploration into eight probe areas plus a critic phase, while keeping final implementation in the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run used no workflow or delegation and kept exploration, implementation, and checks in one local agent path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel breadth produced many child owners for probes; serial used a narrower single-owner path through implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed for probe scopes and asked for notes in shared /tmp/notes paths; the critic was supposed to consume all notes after the probe phase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated task knowledge locally through direct probes and code generation without cross-agent handoffs or a child-parent interface.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel approach introduced shared notes and child handoff boundaries; serial avoided those interfaces.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented partial config/resource support and embedded resources, but the artifact lacked core main/config/message/template implementation pieces.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a broader implementation tree including main.cpp, config.cpp, configdata.cpp, resources, message, emoji, and templates before timing out.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached a more complete source tree; parallel remained mainly support data/resources after the workflow-heavy exploration phase.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The second workflow was launched in the background, spawned child logs, retried stalled probes, and was killed with result null before the critic could return a complete synthesis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had no child result lifecycle; its local work continued until process timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished child-workflow lifecycle that serial did not have.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used shared /tmp/notes and /tmp/probe-* paths across workflow children and retries, then copied harvested resources into the final workspace.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built and copied resources through one local workspace without child-shared temporary state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared temporary artifact provenance risk that serial did not have.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed many probes and comparisons, but official evaluation compiled neither tests nor solution and the parent had no final integrated acceptance evidence.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed local exact-output checks such as CSS reproduction, but official evaluation also ended at compile_failed with zero tests run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had more local verification of generated components; neither run reached evaluator-aligned integrated acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 23 subagent logs, 878010 workflow-child tokens, 386 child tool calls, and timed out after a killed workflow and partial writes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no workflow child tokens or subagents, stayed within local tools, but also hit the same external timeout before a passing build.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel budget was heavily spent on fan-out and retries; serial budget was spent on direct implementation/probing.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed with compile_failed and 0 of 252 tests passed, so there is no discordant official outcome. The meaningful difference is process and artifact shape: parallel spent large budget on an eight-way probe workflow with repeated stalled retries and produced only partial support/resource/config files; serial stayed local and produced a broader source tree including main/config/message/template code, but it also failed to compile.
parallel_contributors: Eight-way probe fan-out plus repeated stall retries consumed a large share of the parallel run budget before final implementation was assembled.
Shared /tmp notes and probe directories allowed retry children to consume stale artifacts, weakening provenance of harvested resources.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided child lifecycle and shared-note coordination boundaries by keeping all exploration and implementation local.
Serial still exceeded the deadline and delivered a non-compiling artifact despite a broader implementation tree.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel artifact was mainly generated config/resource support and copied static resources, lacking many core modules present in the serial artifact.
Serial attempted more concrete executable modules and local exact-output checks but still had ordinary unfinished/incorrect implementation problems leading to compile failure.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator stopped at compile_failed in both modes, so runtime behavioral quality is not measured by the 252 not_run tests.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are adverse parallel process consequences, not an explanation for a discordant result

candidates.reason: The parallel parent explicitly owned implementation after probing and wrote source/resource/config artifacts; the implementation was incomplete, not ownerless.
There were no separately owned implementation components requiring cross-agent integration; probe outputs informed the parent rather than child-owned code modules.
The parent retained final assembly responsibility and created final-tree source/resource files; the failure was timeout before completion, not lack of an assembly owner.
The parent controlled probing, implementation, and delivery; no separate unowned end-to-end pipeline boundary is directly evidenced.
No single mandatory preflight blocked all productive work; the parent continued local implementation while workflow probes ran.
The parallel run did not complete all investigation as a serial first phase before starting implementation; local config/resource work overlapped with child probes.
The same allocation episode is better classified as Fan-out Budget Exhaustion because the evidence shows broad fan-out and repeated stall retries exhausting the finite budget.

The parent launched an eight-way probe workflow, the workflow repeatedly retried stalled children, and the workflow state records a killed run with 878010 child tokens and 386 child tool calls before a complete build path was delivered.
candidates.realized_consequence: The workflow consumed the finite cell budget and left the parent with only partial config/resource implementation artifacts before timeout.
candidates.near_match_reason: The adverse event is specifically collective fan-out breadth plus repeated stall retries; starvation is a downstream description of the same budget chain.
